How to play

Move around the arena to avoid zombies, then aim with your mouse or I, J, K, and L. Click and hold, or press Space, to fire.

  • ← ↑ ↓ → or WASD to move
  • Defeat the number of zombies shown to clear the round.
  • Choose one of three upgrades between rounds.

Improve your survivor

After each wave, improve your movement speed, reload time, or bullets per shot.

Defeating a zombie earns 2 Pixel Points. Your upgrades stay active for the rest of the run.

Move with the arrow keys or WASD, aim with your mouse or IJKL, and hold the mouse button or Space to fire.
